etymology.historical_story: No single origin can responsibly be assigned to this isolated string. English there's contracts there is or there has, so an omitted apostrophe could explain the spelling. Separately, Theres is recorded among personal-name variants associated with Theresa. These are alternative identifications, not established senses of a Malay word; the original sentence is needed before choosing either history.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先找上下文，再定身份：there's 看撇号，Theres 看人名位置；不要把裸字串直接背成马来语单词。
